scalars.scalar_value: Graduation from high school and two years of experience including general maintenance, warehouse and delivery duties. Other Licenses and Requirements: Valid California Driver's License

items.item_text: resume
transcripts

01. PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT: Answer the following questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. You are not expected to answer at the highest level of each of these items to be qualified. The application will be evaluated for minimum qualifications. Your responses to the supplemental questions below may also be used to determine your qualifications beyond the minimum qualification requirements for this classification in a training and experience (T&E) evaluation. Referring to your application/resume, listing "see resume", or incomplete responses will NOT qualify as a response to any question. Questions that are answered in this method will be considered INCOMPLETE and may result in DISQUALIFICATION. You are required to answer ALL of the supplemental questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. Your responses to these questions are subject to verification and may be assessed in subsequent examination parts. All experience, education, training, and certification must be included in your application in order to be considered. Any sign of deliberate misinformation or intentional exaggeration will result in disqualification from this examination process and possible bar from future employment opportunities with the Ventura County Community College District (VCCCD). Select "Yes" if you have read, understood, and agree to the above statements. Select "No" if you have read, understood, and DO NOT agree with the above statements and voluntarily withdraw your application for this position. Options: Yes | No

02. What is your highest level of education? Please Note: Proof of education will be required. Degrees must be earned from an institution of higher learning recognized by the Council for Higher Education. Foreign degrees and credit units require translation and equivalency established by an agency recognized by the Commission on Teacher Credentialing. Options: High School Diploma or GED equivalent | Associate Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Doctorate Degree | None of the above

03. How many years of experience do you possess performing general building or facility maintenance duties? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | At least 1 year but less than 2 years | At least 2 years but less than 3 years | At least 3 years but less than 4 years | At least 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years

04. How many years of experience do you possess performing warehouse duties? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | At least 1 year but less than 2 years | At least 2 years but less than 3 years | At least 3 years but less than 4 years | At least 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years

05. How many years of experience do you possess performing delivery duties? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | At least 1 year but less than 2 years | At least 2 years but less than 3 years | At least 3 years but less than 4 years | At least 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years

06. Do you possess a valid California Driver's License? Options: Yes | No, but I possess a valid Driver's License from another state and am willing to obtain a California Driver's License if selected for the position | No

07. Which of the following general maintenance and repair duties have you performed as part of your work experience? (Select all that apply) Options: Identifying facility maintenance problems and coordinating corrective action | Performing minor repairs to building fixtures or facilities | Performing general carpentry tasks | Preparing surfaces for painting and applying paint or other finishes | Assembling, installing, or repairing furniture | Installing, repairing, or replacing doors, locks, shelving, or other building fixtures | None of the above

08. Describe your experience performing general building and facility maintenance, including minor repairs, painting, furniture assembly, and other routine maintenance activities. Please include in your response: a. The organization(s) in which you gained this experience b. The types of facilities or buildings you maintained c. The types of maintenance and repair work you performed d. Your specific responsibilities and level of independence e. The tools or equipment you used to complete the work If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

09. Which of the following warehouse duties have you performed as part of your work experience? (Select all that apply) Options: Receiving and unloading shipments | Transporting supplies or equipment between multiple facilities or locations | Inspecting deliveries for damage or accuracy | Verifying shipments against purchase orders or packing slips | Storing and organizing warehouse supplies, materials, or equipment | Pulling, packing, and preparing items for distribution or delivery | Identifying or resolving shipment discrepancies | None of the above

10. Describe your experience performing warehouse operations, including shipping, receiving, inspecting deliveries, storing materials, and preparing items for distribution. Please include in your response: a. The organization(s) in which you gained this experience b. The types of materials, equipment, or supplies you handled c. Your responsibilities for receiving, inspecting, storing, and distributing items d. Your experience verifying shipments against purchase orders or packing slips e. Any experience identifying or resolving shipment discrepancies If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

11. Which of the following transportation and delivery duties have you performed as part of your work experience? (Select all that apply) Options: Driving a vehicle to pick up or deliver supplies, materials, furniture, or equipment | Loading and unloading supplies, furniture, or equipment | Securing materials or equipment for safe transportation | Coordinating or scheduling deliveries to multiple locations | Verifying the accuracy and completeness of items being delivered | None of the above

12. Describe your experience transporting, loading, unloading, and delivering supplies, equipment, furniture, or other materials. Please include in your response: a. The organization(s) in which you gained this experience b. The types of vehicles used to perform deliveries c. The types of materials or equipment transported d. Your responsibilities for loading, unloading, securing, and delivering materials e. Your experience coordinating deliveries to multiple locations or departments If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

13. Which of the following maintenance and warehouse tools or equipment have you operated as part of your job duties? (Select all that apply) Options: Forklift | Pallet jack (manual or powered) | Dolly, hand truck, or furniture-moving equipment | Power drills, saws, or similar power tools | Hand tools used for general building maintenance | Ladders or other equipment used to access elevated work areas | None of the above

14. Describe your experience operating tools and equipment used in maintenance and warehouse operations, such as forklifts, pallet jacks, dollies, drills, saws, and other hand or power tools. Please include in your response: a. The organization(s) in which you gained this experience b. The specific tools or equipment you have operated c. The types of tasks you performed using the equipment d. Your level of experience and independence in operating the equipment e. Any related training or certifications you have completed If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

15. How many years of experience do you possess maintaining inventory records, processing requisitions or purchase orders, tracking deliveries, or documenting maintenance activities? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | At least 1 year but less than 2 years | At least 2 years but less than 3 years | At least 3 years but less than 4 years | At least 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years

16. Describe your experience maintaining inventory records, processing requisitions or purchase orders, tracking deliveries, or documenting maintenance and repair activities. Please include in your response: a. The organization(s) in which you gained this experience b. The types of records or documents you maintained c. Your responsibilities for inventory tracking, requisitions, purchase orders, or maintenance records d. The computer systems, software, or other tracking methods you used e. Your experience identifying or resolving discrepancies in records or inventory If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

17. Which of the following training courses or certifications have you completed? (Select all that apply) Options: Forklift operator training or certification | Workplace safety or occupational hazard prevention training | Safe lifting, material handling, or ergonomics training | General building maintenance or repair training | Emergency response, evacuation, or workplace emergency preparedness training | None of the above

18. Candidates who are successful in this examination process may be contacted for future employment opportunities (within this classification) that may be at a different site than where the current vacancy is located. Which locations within VCCCD are you willing to work? (Check all that apply.) You will only be considered for vacancies at locations at which you indicate you are willing to work in response to this question. Options: District Administrative Center (Located in Camarillo) | Moorpark College | Oxnard College | Ventura College

19. The testing process will require access to a computer with a camera, microphone, speakers, and a reliable connection to the internet. If you do not have access to one or more of these components and would like to request alternate testing accommodations, please indicate so below. Options: I do NOT have access to one or more of the required components and would like to request alternate testing accommodations. | I have access to ALL of the required components and do not need alternate testing accommodations.

20. Please indicate the type of job (fulltime and/or part-time) AND the type of work (regular and/or temporary) that you are willing to accept. (Check all that apply). You will only be considered for vacancies with the type of job AND work that you are willing to accept. Options: Full-time Job | Part-time Job | Regular/Permanent Work | Temporary Work
Graduation from high school and two years of experience including general maintenance, warehouse and delivery duties. Other Licenses and Requirements: Valid California Driver's License

Drive a District vehicle to various locations to pick up and deliver goods including documents, deposits, mail, supplies, furniture and equipment; load truck with appropriate supplies and equipment, assure deliveries comply with quantity and product specifications. E Perform a variety of general and semi-skilled duties in the maintenance and repair of assigned facilities, utilities, grounds and equipment, including minor tasks in electrical work, carpentry, plumbing and painting; assure a safe environment for students and staff. E Perform a variety of duties related to the shipping, receiving, storing and issuing of District supplies, equipment and other assigned goods; assure supplies, equipment and other goods are delivered in a timely manner. E Receive, unload and inspect shipments for damage and conformity to purchase order specifications and packing slips; review shipments for accuracy; contact vendors regarding shortages, damaged goods or other discrepancies; tag equipment for inventory identification. E Shelve and store items received in the appropriate section of the warehouse; design and lay out warehouse storage areas and shelf arrangements; maintain warehouse and vehicle in a safe, clean and orderly manner. E Fill and process requisitions; pull, pack and prepare items or supplies for delivery according to established procedures; unload and issue stock in accordance with approved requisitions; prepare and weigh damaged, excess or incorrect items for return to vendors. E Perform a variety of general maintenance and carpentry tasks; construct, alter, repair, replace and inspect structures including cabinets, shelves, partitions, accessories, bulletin boards, counters, doors, paneling, window frames, walls, door locks and a variety of special fixtures; assemble and repair furniture; replace tiles and carpet as needed. E Perform troubleshooting and minor repair to electrical fixtures, equipment, systems and other installations; replace light fixtures, ballasts, switches, fuses, outlets and other electrical accessories; trace out wiring, perform diagnostic tests on system components and replace defective wires and parts. E Perform a variety of plumbing duties in the maintenance and repair of faucets, drinking fountains, toilets, urinals, sinks, pipes, valves, pumps and other fittings and fixtures; inspect and repair leaks, obstructions and general system failures. E Prepare surfaces for painting; apply a variety of surface coatings such as paint, stain, varnish, enamel, lacquer or other protective or decorative finishes; operate a brush, roller or spray gun to apply a variety of surface coverings to various surfaces. E Prepare and maintain a variety of records and reports related to purchase orders, deliveries, supplies, record retention, equipment, inventory, maintenance, repairs and assigned activities; establish and maintain filing systems. E Operate a variety of warehouse and maintenance equipment including forklifts, pallet jacks, dollies, drills, saws and various other hand and power tools; utilize a variety of office equipment including a calculator, copier, computer and assigned software; arrange for vehicle and equipment maintenance and repairs as appropriate. E Communicate with District personnel and outside agencies to exchange information, coordinate activities and resolve issues or concerns related to purchase orders, deliveries, discrepancies, inventory, maintenance, repairs and assigned activities. E Work collaboratively and professionally with faculty, staff, students, and stakeholders from diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, and ethnic communities. E Demonstrate cultural humility, sensitivity, and equity-mindedness in working with individuals from diverse communities; model inclusive behaviors; and achieve equity in assignment-related outcomes. E Perform related duties as assigned. E = Essential duties
